content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Home medical equipment and pharmacy delivered to patients, not hospital software or revenue cycle services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Employer HR, benefits and payroll outsourcing, not hospital clinical software or billing services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Clinical staffing and locum tenens placements; it does not sell EHR or revenue cycle software or outsourcing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Donor, fundraising and education software for nonprofits and schools; healthcare is only a minor segment."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Cloud EHR, practice software and outsourced revenue cycle billing sold to healthcare providers, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for telecom and media operators, not healthcare providers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Free physician networking sold as pharma marketing and trial recruitment; no hospital software or billing business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer service and knowledge software across industries, not hospital clinical or billing systems."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Patient experience surveys and benchmarking for hospitals; not EHR, revenue cycle or hosted hospital operations software."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Payroll and HR software for general employers across industries, not healthcare provider software."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Physician staffing for neonatal, maternity and anesthesia care, billed to payers; no software business."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Mainly medical and dental products; its health IT and coding services are only a small part of the business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Cloud applications for pharma and life sciences companies, not hospital EHR or revenue cycle software."}]}
